text:
Jordan: Quick heads-up: AWS Savings Plans coverage for eu-west-1 GPU families (p4/p3) dropped to ~61% this month. We have a set of 3yr reserved contracts that roll in 8 days. Need decision on renew vs convert to SP or partial scaleback.
cost-bot: Automated alert: reservation_utilization=61% coverage_drop=-12% MoM. Details: https://console.aws.amazon.com/cur?reportId=abc123
Lee: Can you drop the utilization export? I want instance-family + cluster breakouts.
Jordan: Exported: s3://redwood-costs/exports/2026-02/ri-utilization-eu-west-1.csv — internal link. Also running a quick CE query.
Jordan: ```bash
aws ce get-reservation-utilization --time-period Start=2026-02-01,End=2026-02-28 --granularity MONTHLY --filters 'Region=eu-west-1' --metrics 'UtilizationPercentage,MatchedHours'
```
Sam: TL;DR: if utilization stays low we should consider converting a portion to Savings Plans or selling smaller RIs. Need to model amortized cost vs potential SP discount.
Maya: I'll run the model with three options: 1) auto-renew all 3yr 2) convert to 1yr or SP 3) sell partial and shift to on-demand. Posting a spreadsheet by tomorrow EOD.
Lee: Note: some reservations are 'sticky'—tied to Dedicated pools and customer VPCs. Can't touch those. Jordan, can you flag them?
Jordan: Yep. I'll produce a 'do not touch' list (sticky-reservations.csv) and a separate 'candidate-for-sell.csv'.
Sam: Also verify whether GPU families are eligible for Compute SP in our account. I remember edge-cases with marketplace AMIs and Dedicated hosts.
Maya: Good point. I'll include eligibility checks in the model and a short sensitivity analysis.
Jordan: Can we huddle 30m tomorrow 10:30 to agree next steps? @Maya @Sam @Lee :calendar:
Maya: 10:30 works for me.
Lee: Works for me too.
cost-bot: FYI: detected an on-demand price variance in us-east-1 for g5 instances (+6%). Not directly related but may impact cross-region routing decisions.
Jordan: Great — I'll own the decision doc. Target: proposal posted by Fri EOD with recommended renew/convert split and P&L impact. :white_check_mark:
Sam: I'll help run the sell/convert playbook if we go that route.
Maya: I'll post the sheet and results in this thread when ready.
